entry_state: Connected insurance groups close at cash/equity88.3, but late treaty recognition and invalid CSM pooling produce different interim income. Loss components include finance and remain within measured balances. Finance, service, incurrence and settlement are separate atomic events; exact retry returns its original receipt without rewriting the current state. Acquisition-cost timing and LIC finance are also distinct; the LIC profit schedule uses claim-incurrence10%, not inception5%. Section12.8.1 continues after288.
exit_state: Direct-participation eligibility depends on inception findings and actual rights. A minimum guarantee makes retained share nonlinear. The two-state replication prices the floor9 using q1/2, while physical up probability3/4 gives expected top-up4.5. Joint financial/mortality histories keep those measures separate. Variable-fee movements distinguish pass-through returns,unearned fee,loss absorption and eligible mitigation. Partial treaty recovery applies50% to covered loss8, giving4 rather than10 on the entire loss20. Section12.11.1 ends294; the enclosing treaty-changes section continues.

findings.observation: The guarantee payoff explains nonlinear retained amounts without pretending to price them. Direct-participation admission and held assets remain separate questions.
